raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw `amount` values carry a leading '$' (e.g. '$75.13' in batch 12, and the lexicographic min '$10.07'), while other batches are plain decimals. The silver cast to DECIMAL(12,2) fails on those strings, and all rows are USD, so stripping only a leading '$' before the cast should recover the correct amounts. The regex is limited to the leading '$', so any other unexpected format still fails loudly rather than being silently miscast.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(regexp_replace(amount, '^[$]', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
